data.one_liner: Store and decode JWT tokens securely on device with helper methods for expiration and refresh flows.
data.what_it_does: It stores JWT and refresh tokens using secure storage, decodes their payloads, and provides helper methods to check expiration dates, token age, and token validity without manual base64 parsing.
use_when: You need to store and manage authentication JWTs and refresh tokens securely
You need a quick way to check if a token is expired or extract its payload and expiration date
avoid_when: You require complex cross-platform state management solutions beyond authentication sessions
strengths: Simplifies JWT payload decoding and expiration checking
Built-in support for access and refresh token pairs
Allows inspecting tokens directly without touching secure storage
weaknesses: Relies on device secure storage which can occasionally require platform-specific configuration
Does not handle full OAuth or credential exchange flows on its own
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package dependency to pubspec.yaml and ensuring standard platform secure storage dependencies are configured.
